name: io.github.Abhishekkumar2021/sql
title: SQL
description: Read-only SQL querying and schema introspection over Postgres and SQLite, with a gated write mode. Pure-JS.

environmentVariables.name: DB_CONN_default
environmentVariables.description: Connection URL for the 'default' connection (postgres://… or sqlite:/abs/path). Additional connections use DB_CONN_<name>. Carries credentials — treated as secret.

environmentVariables.name: DB_WRITABLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to enable the write tools (execute, execute_script).
